Only {{part|pl}} with the Berserk <c:ff00ff>sub-skill<c>
can use <c:ff00ff>Berserk<c>.

These are the {{part|pl}} showing this
Berserk command.

First, use the <c:ff00ff>D-Pad<c> to select
a {{part}} that can use Berserk.

After selecting the {{part}}, press
<c:ff00ff>the same D-Pad direction<c> again.

Berserk builds up momentum. The
higher
the legs' <c:ff00ff>{{mobility}}<c>, the more power.

Confirm the command with the $*
button.
